scope: Curated text-only adaptations; IDs outside this file are not included. Layouts and English traits are adapted for OpenMind; palettes are OpenMind presets.

traits.zh-CN: 极简线描、连续线、概念隐喻、人与空间一体化、智性幽默。
traits.en: Continuous ink lines, minimal detail, generous white space and a clear conceptual metaphor.

traits.zh-CN: 松散黑线、怪萌人物、少量点色、白底、日常吐槽与尴尬幽默；人物轮廓优先于细节堆砌，脸型、头身比例与手脚形状要形成清楚而独立的视觉语言；表情偏冷脸、尴尬或突然夸张，姿态要有明确喜剧节奏，避免统一的可爱微笑。
traits.en: Loose black outlines, distinctive silhouettes, restrained spot color and expressive comic timing.

traits.zh-CN: 黑白钢笔、密集排线、维多利亚气息、古怪冷峻黑色幽默。
traits.en: Fine black ink, dense crosshatching, antique texture and dramatic light-dark structure.

traits.zh-CN: 轮廓清晰的大面积平涂色块塑造形体；造型适度概括与圆润几何化，保留关键识别特征；每个区域最多两级平面明暗与清晰硬边阴影，通过色块明度、冷暖和面积对比表现空间层次；色彩明亮清爽、柔和通透，纯净平滑的画面质感；极简主义、简洁现代，具有轻盈的现代商业插画与编辑插画感
traits.en: Simple geometric silhouettes, clean flat color regions, crisp shadows and restrained depth.

traits.zh-CN: 儿童蜡笔手绘绘本风、粗蜡笔涂抹质感与明显手绘肌理、低幼绘本插画、童真可爱、造型简化与平视视角、画面干净简约、温暖柔和马卡龙配色、明亮轻快、线条自然稚拙、整体温暖治愈。
traits.en: Visible coarse crayon texture, simplified childlike shapes, a calm front view and warm light colors.

traits.zh-CN: 大量白纸、轻水彩、低覆盖率、柔和湿边。
traits.en: Lots of unpainted paper, light transparent washes, soft wet edges and low pigment coverage.

traits.zh-CN: 铅笔轮廓、轻柔彩铅、纸纹、生活记录。
traits.en: Soft pencil contours, delicate colored-pencil shading, paper grain and everyday details.

traits.zh-CN: 双色套印、轻微错版、粗颗粒、纸张质感。
traits.en: Two limited ink colors, coarse grain, slight registration offset and tactile paper.

traits.zh-CN: 柔和水彩、季节与旅行、自然、治愈留白；人物轮廓优先于细节堆砌，脸型、头身比例与手脚形状要形成清楚而独立的视觉语言；上色保留透明叠染、柔软边缘和纸纹，允许轻微颜色不均与留白。
traits.en: Seasonal natural subjects, translucent watercolor, softened edges and generous quiet space.

traits.zh-CN: 手作触感软萌3D黏土定格动画风、圆润柔和造型与趣味夸张身体比例、微颗粒手作黏土肌理、生动鲜明的个性化角色、介于定格动画玩偶与现代儿童插画绘本之间的温暖美学。
traits.en: Rounded three-dimensional forms, subtle handmade clay grain and distinct expressive proportions.

palettes.name: 蓝红套印 / Blue and coral

layouts.guidance: Place a short headline and supporting copy above one complete main illustration; maintain a clear top-to-bottom reading order.
Make a supplied quotation the focal text, emphasize one keyword and keep illustrations secondary. Never fabricate a quote or attribution.
Separate the headline zone from a neatly spaced list; give each point a small related visual and consistent alignment.
Use a concise oversized headline as the composition, with only a few small illustrations and ample empty space.
Pair the actual source photo with its illustrated counterpart in equal panels. Preserve aspect ratios and framing. Use the deterministic compositor for the original panel.
Align two alternatives across shared comparison rows, with one concise statement or icon in each cell.
Arrange distinct steps along a clear directional path. Each step gets a small visual and a short label; connecting arrows show order.
Place ordered dated milestones along one axis. Keep intervals or labels honest and visually distinguish major milestones.
Use separated horizontal layers to show hierarchy or a system stack. Make level names and containment relationships explicit.
Label two meaningful axes and place content in four readable quadrants. Do not invent quantitative positions unsupported by the source.
Put one core topic at the center, use clearly separated branches for major concepts, and attach concise supporting ideas.
Use editorial hand-drawn visual metaphors, short annotations and structured grouping to explain a real concept on a clean background.
Use four equal panels with setup, development, change and payoff. Keep characters consistent and read left to right, then top to bottom.
Make the real product large and recognizable, on a simple background with only supported minimal copy.
Keep the real product central and photorealistic. Place three to five short, fact-based buying reasons around it with unambiguous callouts.
Show the real product in an appropriate use environment, preserving its actual shape and branding and avoiding invented capabilities.
